meta.title: Award seat cost calculator: illustrative inputs
meta.note: Invented flight, fares, demand and costs. Not any airline's or programme's data.

flight.label: An invented 3½-hour domestic flight, economy cabin only

marginalCostNotes.fuel: Extra fuel to carry about 100 kg (passenger and bag) for 3½ hours, at roughly 3–4% of the extra weight burned per hour and a jet fuel price near US$185 a barrel (IATA/Platts, September 2026).
marginalCostNotes.catering: Meal, drinks and amenities for one more passenger.
marginalCostNotes.fees: Per-passenger airport, handling and distribution costs the airline pays itself (taxes the award passenger pays are left out).

presets.name: Off-peak midweek
presets.blurb: Few people fly: the airline files its lowest fares and still expects to fill about 62% of the seats.

presets.name: Average
presets.blurb: A typical day: normal fares and expected demand of about 86% of the seats.

presets.name: Peak holiday
presets.blurb: Everyone wants to go home: peak fares, a richer mix of late, higher-fare bookings, and more demand than seats.
